name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted network video recorder with object, motion and face detection for IP cameras, running on the CPU with recordings kept on persistent volumes.

alerts.message: Authentication is enabled and the first visit opens an onboarding page: create the admin account right after deploying, before anyone else reaches the URL.
No cameras are configured. Add them in the web UI under Settings > Configuration, save, then reload or restart from the editor. Cameras must be reachable from this server over RTSP.
